notes: Fixed: the Rotting Stag's second stun wolf no longer spawns inside the arena wall. The codex now spells out his wolves' pounce and the Colossus's rounds.

The Ossuary Colossus is reworked: walled into the crypt, his arms slam, slap and clap; break them to raise his Wardens, then he tears free and hunts you on foot. Ride the moving ledges. Boss feedback for the Colossus is open again.
The Rotting Stag is reworked: thorns fly when he charges, a new enraged Root Rush, and his wolves now pounce and pin you. Boss feedback for the Stag is open again. Fixed: wolves spinning in place.
Boss fights are now recorded (positions and damage only, no video) to help tune the bosses. Fixed: the Ranger's Hunting Pack capstone now works.
Visual enhancement to move the game closer to the marketing look and feel. Also fixed: enemies no longer spin when you're right above them.

Fixes: the Rotting Stag no longer gets stuck on the wall after a slam (his follow-up charges now run). No more input lag at low or critical health. Up + Attack now has a 1s cooldown for every class; the Paladin's air up-thrust is once per jump and resets when you land.
New: after each Normal boss, a quick optional survey asks how the fight felt (fun, mechanics, difficulty, length). Tell us what you think of each boss!
New: in-game Codex and Feedback (title screen and pause menu), and a .deb package for Debian/Ubuntu alongside the AppImage. Controls screen fixed.
Execute legendaries nerfed: execute below 10% HP, bosses there take +50% spender damage (was 20% and double)
